lead_time.reason: Head commit → first deployment success; unavailable when no deployment or missing commit evidence

change_failure_rate.reason: Only changes with a full 24h observation window; requires attested incident ledger

recovery_time.reason: Only real resolved incidents; no incidents means N/A, not zero

lead_time_scope: deployed head commit; not every commit in a release
assumptions: All timestamps, release IDs and incidents are fictional.
The synthetic ledger is complete by construction; no real QA attestation.
All 12 feature releases have a full 24-hour observation window.
The separate rollback is excluded from deployment frequency and lead time.
